title: The Lantern Against the Wind
subtitle: A MONDSTADT MYSTERY
ending_title: A song returned to the sky.
disclosure: Original fan story · AI illustration & voices · Unofficial

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: At dusk, the Traveler found a lantern floating above the bridge.
lines.zh: 暮色中，旅行者发现一盏灯笼漂浮在桥上。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: Wait. That lantern is moving against the wind.
lines.zh: 等等。那盏灯笼正逆着风移动。

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: Well, even lanterns get tired of following everyone else.
lines.zh: 嗯，连灯笼也会厌倦一直跟着别人走呢。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: You know something, don't you?
lines.zh: 你知道些什么，对吧？

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: Only that the wind isn't carrying it. Listen.
lines.zh: 我只知道，不是风在带着它走。听。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: A faint melody drifted from the paper lantern.
lines.zh: 一段微弱的旋律从纸灯笼里飘了出来。

vocab.note: 这里修饰声音，不是“晕倒”

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: There is a note inside. Can you hold it still?
lines.zh: 里面有张纸条。你能让它停住吗？

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: For you? I suppose the wind can make an exception.
lines.zh: 为你？我想，风可以破个例。

vocab.note: 这一次不按通常的规则来

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: The lantern settled into her hands. She unfolded the note.
lines.zh: 灯笼缓缓落入她手中。她展开了纸条。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: When the city falls silent, return my song to the sky.
lines.zh: 当城市归于寂静，请将我的歌送回天空。

vocab.note: fall + 形容词：进入某种状态

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: A song? I thought we were looking for treasure.
lines.zh: 一首歌？我还以为我们在找宝藏。

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: That depends. What counts as treasure to you?
lines.zh: 那得看情况。对你来说，什么才算宝藏？

vocab.note: What counts as treasure? 什么算宝藏？

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Which clue made the lantern unusual?
lines.zh: 是哪条线索让灯笼显得不寻常？

options.feedback: 找到了！against 表示与风的方向相反。
再想想：荧说的是 against the wind，意味着逆风。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Against the wind. Something inside was guiding it.
lines.zh: 逆着风。是灯笼里的某种东西在指引它。

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: This tune... I heard it here, years ago.
lines.zh: 这段曲调……多年前，我曾在这里听过。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: Can you remember the ending?
lines.zh: 你还记得结尾吗？

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: No. But perhaps it doesn't need the same ending.
lines.zh: 不记得了。但也许，它不需要同一个结尾。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: He played three gentle notes. The lantern began to rise.
lines.zh: 他轻轻拨响三个音符。灯笼开始升起。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: Should we let it go?
lines.zh: 我们该放它走吗？

vocab.note: let + 宾语 + 动词原形

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: Some things find their way home only when we let go.
lines.zh: 有些东西，只有我们放手，它们才能找到回家的路。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: She opened her hands. This time, the lantern followed the wind.
lines.zh: 她松开了双手。这一次，灯笼顺着风飞去。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: Venti? Was that your song?
lines.zh: 温迪？那是你的歌吗？

lines.speaker: venti
lines.en: Mine? Well... buy me a drink, and I might tell you.
lines.zh: 我的？嗯……请我喝一杯，我也许会告诉你。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Before she could answer, the bard was already walking away.
lines.zh: 她还没来得及回答，吟游诗人已经转身离去。

lines.speaker: lumine
lines.en: Of course. Some mysteries come with a bill.
lines.zh: 果然。有些谜团，是附带账单的。

vocab.note: come with a bill = 还得付账
